outcome.smote_name_as_printed: SMOTE (Appendix A.1 text and Table 8 only; Tables 9-12 column headers do not name it)

chosen.metric: F_betaM (mean F-beta measure) [%], no G-mean/AUC table exists; AvAcc in Table 9, CBA Table 11, CEN Table 12
chosen.condition: 20 real datasets, no added label noise, 30x2-fold CV, Appendix A.1 comparison

outcome.stat_test: Post-hoc Nemenyi test, 95% confidence; asterisk in Table 13 marks significant difference from MC-MBRC

win_claim.quote: compared with state-of-the-art methods, the proposed method makes significant statistical improvements in different classification performance metrics and is robust to data containing class overlap and label noise.

uncertain: Tables 9-12 (p.10-11) print the column headers MDO, CURE_SMOTE, NRAS, kmeans_SMOTE, MC-CCR, MC-MBRC, identical to main Tables 3-6, but Appendix A.1 (p.12) says these tables compare SMOTE, Random, BLSMOTE, SMOTE-IPF, BoostOBU. Values differ from Tables 3-6, so headers look copied by mistake. I took the first column (printed MDO) as SMOTE by position and by closeness to the appendix tables 14-16 where MDO ~ SMOTE; NOT confirmed by the paper (p.10).
